doc: Checks D_80086C00[a0].field_2; if it equals 1, calls func_80059D60() and if the result is 3, stores it back into D_80086C00[a0].field_2. Always returns (the possibly-updated) D_80086C00[a0].field_2.

globals.decl: S_80086C00 D_80086C00[8]; // typedef struct { s16 field_0; s16 field_2; s8 pad4[4]; u16 field_8; u16 field_A; } S_80086C00; (12 bytes/entry). This function only touches field_2 (offset 0x2, s16); field_0 (offset 0x0) and field_8/field_A (offsets 0x8/0xA, u16) are inferred from the sibling w_8005B2C8.c view (which used pad4[6] covering offsets 2-7 since it never touched offset 2) -- reconciled here by splitting that pad into field_2 (offset2, s16) + pad4[4] (offset4-7) so both views agree on the 12-byte total size and the 0x8/0xA fields.
